meta.title: Technology and data security | Intello
meta.description: How we use technology to run your logistics processes better and how we look after your data: access, backups, traceability and separation of duties.

header.title: Technology in service of the process
header.lede: We do not sell software or headcount: we use technology to run your processes with fewer errors and more visibility. And we handle your data like an operation.

usage.title: We automate the repetitive
usage.lede: Work smarter with technology, not harder. That is how hyper-productivity shows up in every account.

items.title: Tracking platforms
items.text: ETA cross-checked on shipping line and carrier platforms, and satellite tracking with a geofence 20 km from the destination port.

items.title: Automatic alerts
items.text: Scheduled status sweeps and triggers such as the pre-alert five days before ETA.

items.title: Automated ETL
items.text: Daily and weekly extraction, cleansing and validation against master records, and updates from tracking events.

items.title: Dashboards and reports
items.text: Business intelligence suites with metrics by country, account, shipment and item, and automated reports by country.

items.title: Your portals and systems
items.text: We work in your tools and upload status to your own portals, without changing how you serve your clients.

items.title: Technovation
items.text: The team's improvement ideas go through Technovation, which confirms they can be applied and automated.

pipeline.title: Every process we run
pipeline.titleAccent: leaves data that feeds it back

steps.title: Documented process
steps.body: SOP, RACI and checkpoints defined for each operation.

steps.title: Traced execution
steps.body: Every action is logged with its shipment, date and owner.

steps.title: Automated ETL
steps.body: Extraction, cleansing and validation against master records.

steps.title: Indicators
steps.body: Granular performance metrics, alerts and trends.

steps.title: Continuous improvement
steps.body: Decisions and adjustments that feed back into the process.

security.title: Your data, handled
security.lede: What we do today, stated plainly, and what is still on our roadmap.

items.title: Access management
items.text: Centralized identity and access control, with permissions by workspace and role.

items.title: Scheduled backups
items.text: Operational and client information is backed up on defined routines.

items.title: Your agreements, kept
items.text: We work under your data processing agreements and your supplier codes of conduct.

items.title: Traceable by design
items.text: Every action leaves a record: which shipment, when and who.

items.title: Separation of duties
items.text: Operations and technology run as independent teams.

items.title: SOC 2 Type II
items.text: Security, availability and processing integrity. We will publish it here once it is certified, not before.
